format: X3D 4.0 RigidBodyPhysics, read by the x3d.loom bridge reader

items.note: The adapters read the default range as 'no stop', which is ODE's convention, and since 28 Nov say so in their notes. Clause 37.4.12 read literally stops the hinge at pi; use({ hingeStop: 'x3d' }) applies that.
Inertia is derived from the collision shapes in all three (LOOM-v1 failure mode 140). The kinematic checks here do not depend on it.
Left out on purpose: rigid bars, ideal pins. The strength checks are separate hand formulas, not an engine result.
